# Post hoc agreement ranges of SS (descriptive; generated by agreement_windows.py)

Rule, applied identically to every film: one-decade windows in 0.25-decade steps, admissible if the lower edge is >= 10 x the measured floor and the upper edge <= 1e-9 A/um; agreeing if |SS_TCAD - SS_meas| <= 5 mV/dec; the longest contiguous run of agreeing windows gives the range. Chosen after seeing the data: it describes where the model agrees and is not a test or the reported SS (the reported SS is the on-current-normalised window).
